PRECEPTS OF THE CHURCH
I
You shall attend Mass on Sundays and holy days of obligation.
II
You shall confess your sins at least once a year.
III
You shall receive the Eucharist at least during the Easter season.
IV
You shall observe the days of fasting and abstinence established by the Church.
V
You shall help provide for the needs of the Church according to your abilities.

ST. MARY OF THE ASSUMPTION · SANTA MARIA, CA
WHO WE ARE

The School of Saint Joseph is a Catholic men's brotherhood formed to grow in knowing, loving, and serving our LORD. We are sons, brothers, husbands, fathers, and grandfathers — men who have heard the call to become who we were meant to be, and who refuse to walk that road alone.

We gather monthly for formation — food, fellowship, a talk, Lectio Divina, and prayer. We serve our parish, our priests, and our community. We hold each other accountable, encourage one another in the faith, and remind each other that our identity is in CHRIST JESUS.

"To be encouraged by our brothers and to be an encouragement for our brothers. To remind and be reminded that our identity is in CHRIST JESUS."

SSJ MISSION
OUR OBJECTIVE

To provide a time and place for men to come together and share a love of CHRIST and each other — so that through the power of the HOLY SPIRIT and the WORD of GOD, we may be healed of our brokenness by the GREAT PHYSICIAN, and become the sons, brothers, husbands, fathers, and grandfathers we were created to be.

OUR FORMATION MODEL

Each monthly formation follows the same battle-tested structure:

⚔️  REPORT  — Break into groups, opening prayer
🍕  FOOD & FELLOWSHIP  — Share a meal, share your life
🎙️  FORMATION TALK  — A brother speaks into our lives
📖  LECTIO DIVINA  — Gospel of the coming Sunday
🙏  CLOSING PRAYER  — Hail Mary, together
THE THREE PILLARS
🧠
KNOWING
The faith, deeply
❤️
LOVING
GOD and brother
⚒️
SERVING
Parish and world
OUR PARISHES

SSJ began at St. Mary of the Assumption in Santa Maria, CA and has grown into a dual-parish chapter with brothers from St. Louis de Montfort in Orcutt and Our Lady of Guadalupe in Guadalupe — three parishes, one brotherhood.

A MARIAN GEOGRAPHY

Look at the Central Coast through Marian eyes: St. Mary of the Assumption. Our Lady of Guadalupe. St. Louis de Montfort — the man who wrote Ad Jesum per Mariam. La Purísima Mission. Immaculate Conception. Every church in this valley carries her name or her mystery. The brotherhood did not choose this ground by accident.

OUR PATRON

Saint Joseph — husband of Mary, foster father of JESUS, head of the Holy Family, and Patron of a Happy Death. As Fr. Sebastian Walshe has shown, Joseph the Patriarch of the Old Testament prefigures our patron in seven remarkable ways: both dreamed GOD's will, both fled to Egypt, both refused their master's spouse, both became father to kings. The type becomes the reality. The shadow gives way to the man.

We ask Saint Joseph to be with us — as the man who gave his last breath in the arms of JESUS and Mary, he knows what it is to be a man of GOD to the very end.

SAINT JOSEPH
Patron of a Happy Death
Pray for us.
